title: Can Tesla beat the Tata-Mahindra Empire in India?: Business Case study
description:

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Bharat me TESLA ki entry hone ja rahi hai!! Aur is khabar ke aate hi, poore desh ke EV market me tehelka mach chuka hai!!
aur doston, yeh sirf ek car company ki entry nahi hai…
Yeh Indian market me ek tectonic shift hai!
Ek aisi shift jo Tata, Mahindra jaise Indian EV legends ke liye ek direct challenge ban ke aa rahi hai!
Aur jahan India me log Tesla ka besabri se intezaar kar rahe hain… wahin global markets me Tesla ke liye waqt kuch khaas nahi chal raha!
Ek zamana tha jab Tesla duniya ka raja tha — Electric vehicles ka asli baadshah!
Sales aasman chhoo rahi thi, stocks chaand par the, aur Elon Musk ka naam har akhbaar aur har gali mein goonjta tha!
Lekin doston, jab se Donald Trump wapas power me aaye… Tesla ki kahaani me ek naye struggles ka chapter shuru ho gaya!
Aaj Tesla ke sales har continent me gir rahe hain…
Stock 50% se zyada crash ho chuka hai...
Aur Europe me Tesla ki sales 40% se nosedive kar chuki hain!
Protests, recalls, customer backlash — Tesla ab ek crossroad par khada hai!

🧠 Toh sawaal yeh hai:
* Itne saare problem ki bich Tesla ki team India me kya plan kr rahi hai?
* Tesla ke aane se tata mahindra jaise Indian EV legends par kya asar padega?
* aur sabse important baat ye hai ki Tesla k bharat me aaane se Bharat ko kya fayda hoga??
Ye kahani sirf EVs ki nahi hai… ye kahani hai power ki, technology ki, aur ek naye industrial revolution ki!
aur chaliye shuru krte hain!!
